title: Compact incremental session summaries and compact aggregates for Console telemetry
creator: Lina Morales
description: Goal: produce compact, incremental materializations that power Console dashboards and downstream SLO/cost attribution jobs with lower compute and storage costs. Scope: implement a new compact session summary mart (session_compact_mart) that stores pre-aggregated session fingerprints, route invocation histograms (buckets), median and p95 latency samples, token counts, and model variant tags. Support incremental refresh using event log change-vector (CDC) snapshots and a safe idempotent merge strategy. Benefits: reduced query latency for high-cardinality dashboards, faster rollup pipelines, cheaper nightly recomputes, and better isolation of long tails when slicing by route/model. Acceptance criteria: 1) materialized view updates incremental upsert within target 45m window for typical daily load; 2) end-to-end dashboard refresh queries fall below 2s for 95% of slices; 3) storage reduction >= 6x vs raw session events for the same retention; 4) migration plan and backfill documented with a dry-run option. Implementation notes: - Source inputs: session_event_stream (cdc partitioned by date), route_metadata, model_variant_catalog. - Merge key: (workspace_id, session_id, route_id, invocation_index) with last_seen_ts for conflict resolution. - Pre-aggregations: session_duration_ms, tokens_total, tokens_input, tokens_output, response_latency_ms_median, response_latency_ms_p95, error_count, model_variant, route_tags. - Downstream compatibility: provide stable canonical identifier session_compact_id and mapping table session_compact_id_map for legacy joins. - Rollout: start with internal dashboards, enable canary workspace list, verify against current console_route_activity and sessionized_route_mart results. Migration plan and rollbacks included in docs.
comments: 2026-02-21: Kickoff with Product and Analytics. Agreed on compact schema and primary use-cases: dashboard fast-path, cost attribution micro-batches.
2026-02-28: Eng spike completed — evaluated MERGE-based incremental upserts vs delta-lake compaction. Chose MERGE for idempotency and simplicity with our current ETL runners.
2026-03-04: Design review — Lina and Owen updated shape to include route invocation histogram buckets and stable compact id. PM requested explicit mapping for legacy metrics.
2026-03-09: Implementation started. Initial job writes to dev.staging.session_compact_mart. Observed merge latency ~18m for 12M daily events (good).
2026-03-11: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1248. Requesting review from @ashok (data infra) and @marie (analytics).
2026-03-12: Benchmarks: median write latency 22m, storage reduction 6.4x on 30-day sample. Next: add histogram bucketing logic and canary toggle in Console queries.
